title: MCP FIPS mesh tools and resources
intent: Expose FIPS mesh node state to agent operators through MCP tools and resources without adding REST endpoints.
observed_sources: internal/mcp/dns_tools.go exposes DNS projection read-model tools.
internal/mcp/dns_resources.go exposes healthy DNS endpoints as MCP resources.
domain.DNSEndpoint includes family=mesh, worker_pubkey, FQDN, health, drift_status and materialization metadata.
domain.Worker includes fips_overlay_addr, fips_endpoints and mesh_health for persisted worker state when the worker repository is configured.
implemented_behavior: bahia_fips_list_mesh_nodes returns only FIPS/mesh nodes from DNS mesh endpoint projection and worker FIPS state.
bahia_fips_mesh_status summarizes mesh node health and projection counts without synthetic nodes.
resources/list includes bahia://fips/mesh/node/<hostname> resources for mesh endpoints while retaining existing DNS resources.
constraints: Empty state returns empty lists/status maps instead of demo data.
Read surfaces are backed by configured Bahia DNS projection and worker repository dependencies.
